name: Kachori & Sabzi (Varanasi Style)
ingredients: Urad dal (Split black gram, soaked and coarsely ground)
instructions: 1. Prepare the dough by mixing maida, salt, and oil, then kneading it into a firm dough and letting it rest.
2. Sauté the ground urad dal with hing, ginger-chili paste, fennel, and dry spices until dry to create the stuffing.
3. Roll small dough balls, fill with the dal mixture, seal, and flatten slightly.
4. Deep-fry the kachoris in medium-hot oil on low flame until golden and crispy.
5. For the sabzi, heat mustard oil, temper with cumin and hing, add ginger-chili paste and tomato puree.
6. Add mashed potatoes, water, turmeric, salt, and amchur; simmer until the curry thickens slightly and oil separates.
7. Serve hot, garnishing the sabzi with fresh coriander.
description: Kachori and Sabzi is the quintessential breakfast of Varanasi. Often enjoyed on the bustling ghats or at legendary street-side shops, it represents the heart of Banarasi culinary culture, known for its deep, pungent use of spices and mustard oil, and its heritage as a staple 'Satvik' (without onion/garlic) meal.
